positive.sql: SELECT t.name, t.count_of_visits FROM (SELECT person.name, COUNT(*) AS count_of_visits FROM person_visits JOIN person ON person.id = person_visits.person_id GROUP BY person.name) AS t GROUP BY t.name, t.count_of_visits HAVING t.count_of_visits > 3;

negative.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT person.name, COUNT(*) AS count_of_visits FROM person_visits JOIN person ON person.id = person_visits.person_id GROUP BY person.name) AS t WHERE count_of_visits > 3;

SELECT person.name, COUNT(*) AS count_of_visits
FROM person_visits
JOIN person ON person.id = person_visits.person_id
GROUP BY person.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;

SELECT person.name, COUNT(*) AS count_of_visits
FROM person_visits
JOIN person ON person.id = person_visits.person_id
GROUP BY person.name
HAVING COUNT(*) < 3;
